question: Can separately defined 15m and 5m K1/K2 systems increase usable signal density without sacrificing pre-holdout net expectancy?

owner_authorization.scope: separate 15m and 5m strategy research using timeframe-specific MA, gap and secondary-score parameters

source.15m_contract: UTC-aligned groups of exactly three contiguous 5m rows; incomplete groups dropped before features

window.audit_contamination: aggregate outcomes from this period were already seen in predecessor experiments; never claim untouched validation

core_morphology.k1: directional real body starts on the wrong side of the selected SMA(HL2) and closes on the directional side; zero crossing tolerance
core_morphology.k2: rejection wick reaches the selected SMA(HL2), close is on the directional side, and the complete body stays on that side

secondary_score.aggregation: unweighted arithmetic mean of twelve causal components, each clipped to [0,1]

components.k1_ma_colour: 1 when selected-MA candle colour is directional else 0
components.k2_ma_colour: 1 when selected-MA candle colour is directional else 0
components.path_close_share: share of completed middle bars closing on the directional MA side
components.path_colour_share: share of completed middle bars with directional selected-MA candle colour

selection.method: one preregistered coordinate pass per timeframe on development only
selection.score: median half-year net bp minus 0.5 times population standard deviation
selection.move_rule: candidate must meet sample eligibility, improve robust score by at least 2bp, and not reduce worst-fold net bp by more than 3bp
selection.tie_break: higher robust score, higher worst fold, more events, then closest to initial setting
selection.no_pass: retain incumbent and report best observed arm separately
selection.success_requires: development mean net bp > 0, robust score > 0, and worst fold net bp > -5
selection.claim_limit: exploratory coordinate-selected research default, never global optimum

execution_frozen.initial_stop: exact K2 low for long and K2 high for short

audit_success_gate.interpretation: exploratory only because the audit window is not pristine
